explanation.what: The template name comes from the pull request's own settings file and is joined onto the checkout unconfined, so a .. in it reads any file the runner can, and the action posts what it read.
explanation.why: This change reads the name from .summary/settings.json, which the pull request supplies, where the base read a fixed template.md.
explanation.fix: Resolve the joined path and refuse it unless it stays inside pr/.summary/, after following symlinks, or accept only a bare file name.

arguments.failureScenario: A pull request adds .summary/settings.json holding {"template": "../.git/config"}. join("pr", ".summary", "../.git/config") normalises to pr/.git/config, where actions/checkout wrote the job's token in the http.https://github.com/.extraheader line, and main.ts posts the file as the pull request's comment, so a token that can write to the repository is published on the pull request. "../../../../proc/self/environ" posts GITHUB_TOKEN from the environment the same way.
